User explicitly authorized provider publication and continued implementation. On resumption, provider main already contained the exact retained incremental/refinement patch at ec56b34806c22e26c28ecbd366ef2e323195fc88; ScalaFIM316a157 had already pinned it. Both live refs verified, reverse patch checked; no duplicate commit/push was necessary. Ordinary pinned image305/284, dataset76/62, fit295/286 JVM/JS pass, no override.

Continued implementation: named upper-triangle pair read/write with validity; NIfTI voxelwise absolute and shared OLS normalized covariance (currently shared U repeated physically); covariance accessor applies scale once and uses Gale PSD verification with consumer tolerance/order limits. Independent closedform and byte fixtures verify crosscovariance and axes; indefinite U with zero variance scale refused.

Group now depends on estimates, not fit. EstimateGroup compiles pinned references with mandatory consumer scientific/grid admission, unique participant rows and catalog/pooling/axis checks. Bounded complete-case reads retain pinned receipts, preserve order, reject invalid cells, and open/verify/close one unit at a time. The eager FitGroupAdapter and three legacy suites moved to fit-estimates; group runtime ClassNotFound check proves fitter absent.

Final isolated candidate base faeba828723cb89696f96fdfc481499304f4fe36 (later concurrent design commits excluded) passes warning-clean scalafimCompileAll, JVM estimates10/IO9/group49/fit-estimates11, JS10/3/48/8. All67 changed source/build/test paths match working tree and retained reversible patch. Fresh64MiB writer+relocated reader again handles128MiB payload, independent Python checks16777216 values/validity; fitter absent from reader and group classpaths. Evidence docs/verification/estimate-set-increment/continuation.md plus source manifest/patch/logs/heap receipt.

ScalaFIM implementation remains uncommitted. Remaining full plan: canonical JSON/TSV schemas/spec/golden fixtures, compact shared matrix and pooled persistence, broader geometry/gzip, HDF5, old exporter removal, workflow/PLS Neuro adoption, full crash/concurrency/access matrix. No fullV0 conformance or fullplan completion. Preserve concurrent HRF/design commits; old firstincrement evidence remains historical.
